news.title: Soccer rules panel clarifies VAR process that World Cup red card for Switzerland's Embolo was wrong
news.lede: GENEVA (AP) — Soccer’s law-making panel clarified its guidance to referees which confirmed Switzerland forward Breel Embolo should not have been sent off in the World Cup quarterfinals against Argentina. Embolo’s second yellow card, after a video review for simulating being fouled, changed the momentum of the game in the 72nd minute soon after Switzerland tied the score at 1-1. Referee Joao Pinheiro, of Portugal, gives a red card to Switzerland's Breel Embolo (7), left, during the World Cup quarterfinal soccer match between Argentina and Switzerland in Kansas City, Mo., Saturday, July 11, 2026. news.title: World Cup hero Vozinha forced to change name at new club
news.lede: The 40-year-old became a World Cup hero after his sensational performances for the African nation, most notably against eventual finalists - Argentina and Spain. Following the group stage game against La Roja, Vozinha went from having 50,000 followers on Instagram to over 1 million within 24 hours. During that iconic performance, he made seven saves to earn his home nation a historic result, with Luis de la Fuente's side maintaining a perfect record for the rest of the competition. He currently boasts more than 29.6 million followers on the social media platform and was also named in FIFA's Dream World Cup XI having secured a whopping 40 per cent of the votes.

news.title: World Cup final referee Slavko Vinčić announces his retirement
news.lede: Slavko Vinčić, the 46-year-old Slovenian referee who officiated the World Cup 2026 final between Spain and Argentina, has announced his retirement. The Slovenian Football Association (NZS) announced it on Monday: "One week after the World Cup final in the USA, Slavko Vincic has officially ended his historic refereeing career at the top of the sport," adding that he "consolidated his status as one of the best referees in history." Vinčić was named by the International Federation of Football History and Statistics (IFFHS) as the best referee of the World Cup for maintaining "the clear and firm disciplinary control that characterizes elite refereeing" and received the the prestigious 'Giulio Campanati' award in Italy.Vincic started officiating international matches in 2010 and worked in World Cups 2022 and 2026, and UEFA Euro 2020 and 2024.

news.title: Zidane lands dream job as France hand him reins through 2030 World Cup
news.lede: PARIS, July 28 : France great Zinedine Zidane's long-held ambition to coach the national team became reality on Tuesday when the French Football Federation appointed the former captain and World Cup winner as Didier Deschamps' successor on a four-year contract. The appointment of former Real Madrid manager Zidane comes two weeks after Deschamps' tenure as coach ended following France's fourth-place finish at the World Cup. His final match in charge was a 6-4 defeat by England. "The French team was the only thing I wanted to do," Zidane told reporters.

news.title: NFL stadium used to host World Cup games completes major transformation back to football - 'welcome back'
news.lede: SOFI STADIUM has been given a makeover after hosting eight showdowns during the World Cup. The 70,240-capacity arena staged two USA clashes during the tournament, including the group-opening win over Paraguay. And Spain also featured at SoFi Stadium as they beat Belgium en route to being crowned World Cup champions. But the home of the Los Angeles Rams and Los Angeles Chargers is now back in NFL mode ahead of the new season.

news.title: Cape Verde's World Cup hero keeper Vozinha forced to CHANGE NAME to play for next club
news.lede: WORLD CUP hero Vozinha will don a shirt bearing an unfamiliar name at new club Colo-Colo. The Cape Verde goalkeeper, 40, became an overnight star with a string of heroic performances at this summer‘s tournament. Those displays convinced Chilean giants Colo-Colo to snap him up as a free agent – sealing one of the biggest moves of his career. But under current rules the veteran stopper will not be allowed to start the season with ‘Vozinha’ on his back.

news.title: Lothar Matthäus wary of Jürgen Klopp’s massive responsibility as Germany manager
news.lede: Jürgen Klopp was officially presented as new Germany national team manager on Friday in Frankfurt by the DFB and the former Liverpool, Borussia Dortmund and Mainz manager signed a four-year deal that keeps him in the hot seat through the 2030 World Cup in Morocco, Portugal, and Spain. He replaces Julian Nagelsmann after yet another disappointing performance at a World Cup — a theme that’s been all too familiar for Die Mannschaft dating back to the 2018 tournament in Russia. After Joachim Löw finally stepped down after EURO 2020, Hansi Flick gave it his best before Nagelsmann took the helm, but neither of them could guide Germany back to the promise land and it’s now up to Klopp to steer them in that direction as best he can — which his reputation suggests he’s more than capable of doing. Klopp’s name has been in the mix for the national team job for a very long time.
